Dealing damage with <strand/>Tangles grants Melee Energy per damage instance based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10% 
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 18%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20%
• Players: 25%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 30%
